archive_survey: NASA 2MASS (J) & DSS2 (Red) archival FITS via IRSA FinderChart

epochs.label: NASA DSS2 Red FITS [LOD 1 (Standard Science 720px)] (photographic plates, ~1980s-1990s; not SPHEREx data)

telemetry.data_provenance: 2MASS J-band and DSS2 Red archival FITS. No SPHEREx, WISE, Gaia or CADC values are embedded in this response.
telemetry.noise_filter: Astropy ZScale & AsinhStretch (Authentic NASA FITS Data)

adql_queries.irsa_spherex:
SELECT 'https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/' || a.uri || '?center=' || p.ra || ',' || p.dec || 'd&size=0.1' AS uri,
       p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_lower
FROM spherex.artifact a
JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid
WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 269.45208, 4.69339), p.poly)
  AND p.energy_bandpassname = 'SPHEREx-D1'
ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
adql_queries.mast_gaia:
SELECT TOP 20 source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, parallax, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp
FROM gaia_dr3.gaia_source
WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 269.45208, 4.69339, 0.05))
adql_queries.cadc_neossat:
from astroquery.cadc import Cadc
from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord
import astropy.units as u
cadc = Cadc()
results = cadc.query_region(SkyCoord(269.45208, 4.69339, unit='deg'), radius=0.5*u.deg, collection='NEOSSAT')
